moments.title: Asset allocation is your lunch thali
moments.summary: The analogy is set up: everyone eats rice, dal, sabzi and rotis in different proportions, and a portfolio works the same way — the obsession is with what to buy rather than how much.
moments.evidence: Just like how everyone eats rice, dal, sabzi, rotis in different proportions, your portfolio works the same way.

moments.title: It's not what you choose, it's how you divide it
moments.summary: How much goes into equity, debt, gold or cash is said to depend on age, goals, time horizon and risk appetite — so the question to ask is how much of each, not what to put on the plate.
moments.evidence: How much goes into equity, debt, gold or cash depends on your age, goals, time horizon and risk appetite.
